agyos_skill.intent: Production-ready Docker and docker-compose setup for Odoo with PostgreSQL, persistent volumes, environment-based configuration, and Nginx reverse proxy.
agyos_skill.instructions: This skill provides a complete, production-ready Docker setup for Odoo, including PostgreSQL, persistent file storage, environment variable configuration, and an optional Nginx reverse proxy with SSL. It covers both development and production configurations. - Spinning up a local Odoo development environment with Docker. - Deploying Odoo to a VPS or cloud server (AWS, DigitalOcean, etc.). - Troubleshooting Odoo container startup failures or database connection errors. - Adding a reverse proxy with SSL to an existing Odoo Docker setup. 1. **Activate**: Mention `@odoo-docker-deployment` and describe your deployment scenario. 2. **Generate**: Receive a complete `docker-compose.yml` and `odoo.conf` ready to run. 3. **Debug**: Describe your container error and get a diagnosis with a fix. ```yaml services: db: image: postgres:15 restart: always environment: POSTGRES_DB: odoo POSTGRES_USER: odoo POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} volumes: - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data networks: - odoo-net odoo: image: odoo:17.0 restart: always depends_on:
